import hashlib,json,subprocess
from pathlib import Path
out=Path('.local/e2e');path=out/'schedule-queues-checkpoint.json';v=json.loads(path.read_text());assert v['completed'];campaign=v['report'];payload={'namespace_id':campaign['namespace_id'],'function_ids':campaign['function_ids'],'known_instances':campaign['known_instances']};result=subprocess.run(['python3','-B','e2e/schedule-queue-inspect.py',json.dumps(payload),'--purged'],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=120)
if result.returncode:raise RuntimeError(result.stderr[-2000:])
native=json.loads(result.stdout);before=json.loads((out/'schedule-queues-before.json').read_text());assert native['completed'] and native['physical']['completed'];assert not any(native['counts'].values());assert len(native['functions'])==9 and all(f['purged_at'] for f in native['functions']);assert native['services']==before['services'];assert native['official_sha256']==before['official_sha256'];assert native['original_artifacts']==before['original_artifacts'];assert len(native['embedded_backend'])==34;assert not native['instances'] and not native['containers'] and not native['leases'];assert not any(native['networks'].values()) and not any(native['channels'].values());assert all(g['retired_at'] for g in native['generations'])
assert len(native['firings'])==4 and len(native['invocations'])==148;refused=[f for f in native['firings'] if f['state']=='refused_capacity'];success=[f for f in native['firings'] if f['state']=='succeeded'];assert len(refused)==len(success)==2
for f in refused:assert f['error_code']=='queue_full' and f['invocation_id'] is None
calls={row['id']:row for row in native['invocations']};disconnected=[row for row in calls.values() if row['state']=='disconnected'];succeeded=[row for row in calls.values() if row['state']=='succeeded'];assert len(disconnected)==144 and len(succeeded)==4
for row in disconnected:assert row['http_status']==499 and row['error_code']=='client_disconnected' and not row['admitted_at'] and not row['handler_started'] and row['trigger']=='http' and row['instance_id'] is None
for f in success:
 row=calls[f['invocation_id']];assert row['trigger']=='schedule' and row['state']=='succeeded' and row['resolved_code_hash']==f['code_hash'] and row['schedule_firing_id']==f['id'] and row['handler_started']
assert len([row for row in succeeded if row['trigger']=='http'])==2
v['native']=native;v['counts']={'groups':4,'functions_physically_purged':9,'firings':4,'invocations':148,'receiving_calls_disconnected_before_handler':144,'refusals_without_invocation':2,'successful_handlers':4,'scheduled_successful_handlers':2,'http_successful_handlers':2};v['native_collection_source']=Path(__file__).read_text();path.write_text(json.dumps(v,indent=2)+'\n');print(json.dumps({'completed':True,'counts':v['counts'],'backend_files':34,'original_artifacts':native['original_artifacts']['files']}))
